verdict.rationale: Quo documents an official public MCP server on its homepage and a dedicated MCP support page, which a probe confirmed. The page lists concrete agent capabilities: reading and summarizing inbox messages, sending texts, pulling call history and voicemail transcripts, managing contacts, and reviewing missed calls. It also says no coding is required and offers one-click Claude/ChatGPT connectors. missing for 10: documented connection specifics in the evidence (endpoint URL, auth/OAuth flow for the MCP server), independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working.
